topics.name: Architecture & Deployment
topics.description: Platform Analytics solution components, deployment tasks and sequence, common use cases, personas and stakeholders.

introduction.overview: Architecture & Deployment covers the Platform Analytics solution architecture, including its core components (indicators, breakdowns, dashboards), deployment methodology, common use cases, and the key personas involved in PA implementations.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain represents 10% of the CIS-PA exam. Questions cover PA solution components, the relationship between indicators and breakdowns, deployment task sequence, common use cases across ITSM/CSM/HR, and stakeholder roles.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the PA architecture: indicators measure what you care about, breakdowns slice the data, and dashboards visualize it. Know the deployment sequence from activation through dashboard creation. Identify common use cases per application area.
introduction.examTips: Indicators are the foundation - always start there. Breakdowns add dimensions to your analysis. Deploy in phases: activate plugins, configure indicators, add breakdowns, build dashboards. Know which personas need which views.

topics.name: Indicators & Indicator Sources
topics.description: Source conditions, facts tables, indicator types, configuration properties, and aggregation scripts.

introduction.overview: Indicators are the metrics that Platform Analytics tracks over time. This domain covers indicator types, how indicator sources define what data to measure, configuration properties for customization, and aggregation scripts for complex calculations.
introduction.whyItMatters: This is a major domain at 25% of the exam. Questions focus on indicator types (automated, manual, formula), indicator sources and facts tables, source conditions, configuration properties, and when to use aggregation scripts.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the three indicator types: automated (scheduled data collection), manual (hand-entered values), and formula (calculated from other indicators). Understand indicator sources, facts tables, and how source conditions filter data.
introduction.examTips: Automated indicators run on schedules via data collector jobs. Formula indicators combine other indicators mathematically. Facts tables store collected data points. Source conditions determine which records are counted. Aggregation scripts handle complex logic.

topics.name: Breakdowns & Breakdown Sources
topics.description: Breakdown sources, mappings, breakdown matrix, exclusions, scripted breakdown mapping, and bucket groups.

introduction.overview: Breakdowns allow you to slice indicator data by dimensions like priority, category, or assignment group. This domain covers breakdown configuration, the breakdown matrix for cross-dimensional analysis, and bucket groups for custom groupings.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain is 25% of the exam. Questions cover breakdown types, breakdown sources, breakdown mappings to indicators, the breakdown matrix, exclusions, scripted breakdown mappings, and bucket groups for grouping values.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand how breakdowns add dimensions to indicators. Master breakdown sources (which determine available values) and mappings (which connect breakdowns to indicators). Know when to use the breakdown matrix, exclusions, and bucket groups.
introduction.examTips: Breakdowns answer 'by what dimension' questions. Breakdown sources can be automatic (reference fields) or manual (scripts). The breakdown matrix enables multi-dimensional analysis. Bucket groups combine related values (e.g., P1+P2 = High Priority).

topics.name: Data Collection
topics.description: Data collection process flow, collection configuration properties, fine-tuning and troubleshooting.

introduction.overview: Data Collection is the engine that populates Platform Analytics with data points. This domain covers the data collection process, scheduled jobs, configuration properties for collection frequency and performance, and troubleshooting collection issues.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain is 10% of the exam. Questions cover the data collection process flow, collection jobs and schedules, configuration properties, performance considerations, and troubleshooting when data collection fails or is incomplete.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand how the data collector job runs on schedule to populate facts tables. Know the collection configuration properties that control frequency and performance. Master troubleshooting steps for collection issues.
introduction.examTips: Data collection runs via scheduled jobs. More frequent collection = more data points = better trend visibility but higher system load. Check the PA Admin dashboard for collection status. Common issues include missing indicator sources or failed jobs.

topics.name: Visualization & Dashboards
topics.description: Platform Analytics visualizations, unified filters, choosing visualizations, dashboard management, performance, and KPI Details.

introduction.overview: Visualization & Dashboards covers how to present Platform Analytics data to users, including visualization types, dashboard creation and management, unified filters for consistent filtering, and KPI Details pages for deep-dive analysis.
introduction.whyItMatters: This is a major domain at 25% of the exam. Questions cover visualization types (scorecard, time series, leaderboard), choosing appropriate visualizations, dashboard creation and layout, unified filters, access control, performance, and KPI Details.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know when to use each visualization type: scorecards for current values, time series for trends, leaderboards for rankings. Master dashboard creation, layout, and access control. Understand unified filters and KPI Details pages.
introduction.examTips: Match visualization to the question: 'What's the current value?' = scorecard, 'How is it trending?' = time series, 'Who's performing best?' = leaderboard. Unified filters apply across dashboard widgets. KPI Details provides drill-down analysis.

topics.name: Administration & Advanced Solutions
topics.description: Content packs, platform features for advanced data collection, and Spotlight configuration.

introduction.overview: Administration & Advanced covers maintaining PA implementations, using content packs to accelerate deployment, leveraging platform features for advanced scenarios, and configuring Spotlight for predictive analytics.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain is 5% of the exam. Questions cover content pack usage and deployment, advanced data collection scenarios, Spotlight configuration for anomaly detection, and ongoing PA administration tasks.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand how content packs provide pre-built indicators and dashboards for common use cases. Know advanced collection scenarios like collecting from multiple sources. Master Spotlight configuration for predicting future values.
introduction.examTips: Content packs accelerate time-to-value with pre-built content. Import content packs carefully to avoid conflicts. Spotlight uses machine learning to predict future values and detect anomalies. Regular maintenance keeps PA performing well.
